reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 5 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Trail Blazers (revenge).
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 59 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 201 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: Portland coach Micah Nori returns to Minnesota, where he spent five seasons as Chris Finch's assistant, and admits it will be 'very, very weird' being back. The Timberwolves are without Anthony Edwards for at least two months after knee surgery, while Portland are still missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and this is the second game of a back-to-back between the teams. The angle leans slightly towards Portland keeping it close.
